Answers of payment pages and top-up requests, written by hand after the shapes seen on
live accounts on 2026-11-08. Every id, sum, link, token and address here is made up.

Taken from live answers on 2026-11-09, without anything of the account:
- `aeza-payment-methods.json`: Aeza's own list of payment methods as it is (names, limits,
  icons; nothing account-specific in it);
- `cryptomus-currencies.json`, `cryptomus-methods.json`: what a Regxa invoice's Cryptomus
  page asks for its coins and networks, cut to 12 coins (24 coin-network pairs); every sum,
  rate and fee is replaced with 1.00 or 0.10 and the encrypted `payload` with a stub.
